# Copilot instructions

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before any change: it holds the rules for every AI tool in this repo (non-negotiable rules, layout, tests, git flow). Essentials: never push to `main` (merging deploys to production); keep the Cloudflare free-tier rules; never log or commit keys, tokens or passwords; run the tests listed in AGENTS.md.
